newsitem.title: KENYA: Rwandan guard kills 10 detainees - state agency.
newsitem.headline: Rwandan guard kills 10 detainees - state agency.

text.p: A guard shot and killed 10 genocide suspects held in a cell in southern Rwanda and wounded a number of others before being arrested, Rwanda's state news agency said on Friday.

It said the guard shot the detainees as they tried to escape from a cell in Maraba commune in Butare prefecture on Wednesday. The wounded were taken to Butare university hospital, added the news agency, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation.
There are more than 100,000 Rwandan Hutus in jails in Rwanda accused of involvement in the 1994 genocide of 800,000 Tutsis and Hutu moderates by Hutu troops, militiamen and mobs.
More than 10,000 Rwandan Hutus who fled to Zaire in 1994 in fear of reprisals for the genocide have returned to Rwanda on a U.N. airlift from the northeast Zairean city of Kisangani since April 27.
Amnesty International said last month that most trials in Rwanda for genocide and crimes against humanity were unfair, with defendants presumed guilty unless proven innocent.
The London-based human rights group said there were only 16 defence lawyers in Rwanda for those awaiting trial for genocide.
Special tribunals since last December for genocide suspects held in Rwanda have sentenced at least 29 people to death.
